hero.subtitle: Transform your master career data into tailored, ATS-compliant resumes with Google XYZ-formula bullets, real-time 1–10 quality scoring, and 1-page design precision.

step1.title: Master Career Vault
step1.desc: Store your complete career history, technical stack, projects, and achievements in structured Markdown or guided forms.

step2.title: Target Vacancy & Tailoring
step2.desc: Paste target job postings to synthesize aligned bullets with Google XYZ formula and employer keywords.

step3.title: Live CV & Quality Audit
step3.desc: Inspect calibrated 1–10 quality scores, customize across 7 ATS themes, and export print-perfect PDFs.
